posts.zh:
dsh-bash-terminal 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8ae5c014b68e5726d84d.html
posts.en:
dsh-bash-terminal is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8ae5c014b68e5726d84d.html
